title.en: 322 days as CEO. Then Zuckerberg hired him. What happens to MongoDB?
title.zh: CEO才当322天，就被扎克伯格请走：MongoDB怎么办？

summary.en: CJ Desai leaves MongoDB for Meta’s enterprise AI push; former chief Dev Ittycheria returns as interim CEO. The September 28 move is a hiring, not an acquisition.
summary.zh: CJ Desai离开MongoDB，加入Meta企业AI业务；前任Dev Ittycheria回任临时CEO。事件发生于9月28日，是人事变动，并非公司收购。

title.en: Zverev needed 55 minutes. Can he break Djokovic’s unbeaten Beijing run?
title.zh: 兹维列夫55分钟过关，能破德约在北京的不败纪录吗？

summary.en: A 6-0, 6-3 win over Shang Juncheng earns Zverev a quarter-final against Djokovic. This October 3 report is a preview; the next result remains unknown at the source cutoff.
summary.zh: 6比0、6比3击败商竣程后，兹维列夫将在八强战对阵德约科维奇。本稿依据10月3日报道前瞻，截止核验时下一场结果未知。
